name: Sun Peaks

seo.title: Sun Peaks ski resort guide
seo.description: Canada's second largest ski area: 4,400 acres over three mountains, 144 trails and a village the runs come down through.
seo.twitterDescription: 4,400 acres, three mountains, and a ski-through village.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, terrain by grade, where to stay and how to get to Sun Peaks in British Columbia.

h1: Sun Peaks ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Sun Peaks is 4,400 acres across three mountains, which the resort states makes it Canada's second largest ski area. Fifty-eight per cent of the 144 trails are graded intermediate, the village street has runs coming down through it, and the season runs 21 November 2026 to 4 April 2027.
stayOverview: The village is the unusual part: the runs come down through the street, so most beds are ski-in without being out of town. Kamloops down the valley has the airport.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Almost everything in the village reaches a run directly.
rentalCars: Kamloops airport is about 50 kilometres away, and the village is walkable once you arrive.
